name: FOLFOX-4 (de Gramont)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
source.nccnTemplate: pending - per-disease NCCN Chemotherapy Order Template not yet provided

institution.provenance: textbook-grounded draft; NCCN per-disease template + clinical (StewardMD) + hospital/institutional approval pending

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: give before chemotherapy per NCCN Antiemesis appendix D moderate-emetic-risk tier (oxaliplatin-based regimen)

supportiveCare: antiemetics: moderate emetogenic risk tier (NCCN appendix D) - prophylaxis required on day of treatment
G-CSF: not routinely indicated - FOLFOX-4 is not on the NCCN high-risk febrile-neutropenia list; assess intermediate-risk factors per appendix C, physician-patient discussion
monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle - platinum agent
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle - oxaliplatin

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

drugs.name: OXALIplatin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 123714. 85 mg/m2 IV over 2 hr, day 1 only.

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 123715. 200 mg/m2 IV, days 1 and 2.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (bolus)
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 123716. 400 mg/m2 IV bolus, days 1 and 2, given after leucovorin/oxaliplatin.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (continuous infusion)
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 123716. 600 mg/m2 IV over 22 hr, days 1 and 2, given after the bolus.
